verdicts.reasoning: The items instruct the student to describe the duration by examining a calendar and determining the total elapsed time between two given dates, fulfilling the action of 'Describe'.
The stems prompt students for the duration of an event by calculating the span 'from [Date 1] to [Date 2], inclusive', mapping to the 'duration of an event' clause.
Seeds 42 and 57 explicitly ask 'How many days are there...' setting the unit of the calculated duration to days. The payload also contains 'task_type': 'measure_duration' without 'unit': 'weeks'.
Seeds 11 and 23 explicitly ask 'How many weeks are there...' setting the unit to weeks. Their visual payloads explicitly set 'unit': 'weeks'.
All these seeds render a visual 'Calendar' payload featuring a specific month and year (e.g., September 2025) and highlighted date ranges corresponding to the word problem.
